bug_semantics: The unauthenticated PUT /api/echo/like/:id route directly invoked LikeEcho, whose vulnerable path did only an existence check and an atomic fav_count increment. It performed no authentication, private-echo visibility check, caller/echo deduplication, or rate limiting. An anonymous caller could therefore increment any known echo UUID repeatedly, including a private echo, and each accepted call caused a database write followed by invalidation of the page, today, RSS, and per-echo cache keys, enabling popularity-integrity manipulation and database/cache load amplification.
flaw_origin: Commit 5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de made the existing LikeEcho handler/service/repository chain remotely reachable by adding appRouterGroup.PublicRouterGroup.PUT("/echo/like/:id", h.EchoHandler.LikeEcho()) in internal/router/echo.go. The direct parent already contained the helper chain but had no /echo/like route anywhere under internal/, so this one public-route registration is the smallest change that created the vulnerable anonymous attack path; later refactors preserved that registration.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file commit 5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de shows author L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com>, committer L1nSn0w <l1nsn0w@qq.com>, and only the subject 'feat: 添加点赞功能，更新相关字段名和接口，优化点赞逻辑'; the BIC commit object has no body, trailers, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: The repository-owner advisory https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/security/advisories/GHSA-pj6q-4vq4-r8cg names internal/router/echo.go:12, internal/repository/echo/echo.go:270, and InvalidateEchoCaches at internal/repository/echo/echo.go:51-58; it describes anonymous repeated fav_count increments, private-echo reachability by UUID, a database write plus four cache invalidations per call, declares vulnerable versions <= 4.5.6, and declares 4.7.3 patched. The public alias is https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7xcp-744q-324g.

At v4.5.6 (tag target 60e39455f8720bb50797f4fd2052e8e6c12db448), internal/router/router.go creates public := r.Group("/api") with no JWT middleware while auth := r.Group("/api") receives NoCache and JWTAuthMiddleware. internal/router/echo.go:12 registers PUT /echo/like/:id on PublicRouterGroup. internal/handler/echo/echo.go:235-247 accepts the UUID and calls the service; internal/service/echo/echo.go:265-272 calls repository.LikeEcho then InvalidateEchoCaches; internal/repository/echo/echo.go:270-290 performs an existence-only lookup and fav_count + 1; lines 51-58 clear page, today, RSS, and per-ID caches.

git log -L over setupEchoRoutes and git log -S 'PublicRouterGroup.PUT("/echo/like/:id"' identify 5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de as the first main-history commit that wrote the vulnerable public registration. Its focused diff adds that single line to internal/router/echo.go as part of the like feature. The commit is a normal one-parent cohesive feature commit rather than a merge, move, revert, release commit, or reconstructable squash aggregate, so no decomposition was needed. Commit URL: https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de.

Direct-parent tree verification used 290cf76168997a4d28897a892d3ec6f326d8eadc:internal/router/echo.go and a tree-wide git grep under internal/. That file's Public section is empty and no /echo/like string exists anywhere under internal/. A separate parent-tree grep shows LikeEcho helpers already present in internal/handler/echo/echo.go, internal/service/echo/echo.go, and internal/repository/echo/echo.go, proving that the BIC's new public registration—not later refactoring and not the older unreachable helpers—created remote reachability. Parent URL: https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/tree/290cf76168997a4d28897a892d3ec6f326d8eadc.

Tag membership establishes the source boundary: v2.1.7 (1c4a4fb7949d168cee1b073649d45023961535ec) has an empty Public section in internal/router/echo.go, while v2.1.8 (736687633453a78cda3dc63fe88b54f46d9f9e0a) contains the public like route and is the first version tag containing the BIC. The route remains unguarded in v4.7.2 (88a564fcdd1ca0fbeecd75ed5f522df95372d308). Thus repository history shows affected tagged releases v2.1.8 through v4.7.2; the first-party advisory's stated upper bound <= 4.5.6 does not cover the still-vulnerable v4.6.x and v4.7.0-v4.7.2 source trees, although its patched boundary 4.7.3 is correct.

The source-level fix is cecc2c19b590df85d79ea98457faa143130cd620 (https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/cecc2c19b590df85d79ea98457faa143130cd620), whose message explicitly cites GHSA-pj6q-4vq4-r8cg and whose diff wraps the public route with RateLimitWithIdempotency(2, 5, time.Hour, "id"): a per-IP token bucket returns 429 above the limit and an (IP, echoID) one-hour window aborts duplicate requests before the handler, database write, and cache invalidation. Its direct parent fd320fe3e9021c8d8d284fb274775c018690520e also added the service-layer private-echo visibility gate that rejects anonymous and authenticated non-admin callers before incrementing. Both commits are first contained in v4.7.3, whose tag target is 6ad621d8d461c58f1a1d179c4dfbb741803f8aa5; neither is in v4.7.2. This verifies the 4.7.3 patched boundary and the complete rate-limit/dedup/private-visibility repair.

BIC-only AI attribution used the exact raw commit object for 5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de. It contains one human-named author/committer identity and no message body or trailers. AI markers on later commits, including the fix, were not used to attribute the BIC, as required by the protocol.
reasoning: The vulnerability begins when 5aa2fd32f9f87f0240a33f9aad0bb2db8dc725de registers the already-existing increment handler on the middleware-free public /api group. The parent-tree comparison proves that exact anonymous route was absent immediately before the BIC, and -S/-L history confirms it is the first commit to write the reachable mechanism rather than a move or refactor. Release trees place introduction at v2.1.8, persistence through v4.7.2, and repair at v4.7.3. The completed repair combines fd320fe3e9021c8d8d284fb274775c018690520e's private-echo authorization check with cecc2c19b590df85d79ea98457faa143130cd620's rate limiting and one-hour (IP, echoID) deduplication; cecc2c19b590df85d79ea98457faa143130cd620 is the direct advisory-named fix commit. Finally, the raw BIC commit object has no AI authorship/co-authorship/generation marker and names the same human author and committer, so under the required commit-object-only rule the closed causal verdict is NOT_AI regardless of any AI marker on later fixes.
